cycles.diagnosis: visit_import_from was adding optional parentheses to star imports, producing invalid `from ... import ( * )` output for long star imports; it also made parentheses invisible before fmt-off handling could preserve an import inside an unformatted block.

file_inspections.reason: Inspected the fixture containing the long star import and expected formatted output.
Inspected the fixture showing fmt-off import parentheses should be preserved.
Confirmed the failing fixtures are exercised by BlackTestCase tests using read_data and format equality/stability checks.
Checked the project test entry point and why setup.py test does not accept pytest selectors.
Inspected import formatting, fmt-off handling, line splitting, and invisible parenthesis normalization.

patch_attempt.patch_summary: Changed LineGenerator.visit_import_from to skip custom import parenthesis mutation when the import node is under fmt-off handling or when the import is a star import, letting those nodes be visited normally.

test_rerun.command: wsl.exe -d Ubuntu-24.04 --exec /bin/bash -lc 'export PATH=$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH; export PIP_INDEX_URL=https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/simple; export PIP_TRUSTED_HOST=pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn; export PIP_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT=120; export PIPENV_PYPI_MIRROR=https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/simple; export PIPENV_TIMEOUT=120; cd <PROJECT_ROOT>/workspaces/runs/pybughive_hard_smoke/pybughive_hard_smoke_pybughive_black_234_generic_checklist_seed1/repo; pipenv run python setup.py test'

mistakes.description: Initial attempt to pass pytest-style selectors through setup.py test used an unsupported --addopts option; switched to the task command for reproduction and unittest selectors for narrow reruns.
